['Kl\u00f6ckner & Co. SE '].company_description: Klöckner & Co. SE is a German producer-independent steel and metal distributor. The company's core business is the sale of steel and non-ferrous metals, and it has an established distribution network with approximately 150 locations.

['Edeka Minden-Hannover Stiftung & Co. K.company_description: Edeka Minden-Hannover Stiftung & Co. KG is a German supermarket corporation and one of the largest supermarket chains in Germany.
